title: SAPA SUPREME 💸
subtitle: Broke, stranded, and eating biscuits for dinner.
description: Your account balance hit {$0.01}. You couldn't even afford transport fare back from the embassy. You had to trek home under the sun while Mama hissed at you.
shareTitle: I died of Sapa on the road to Europe!
shareQuote: "Even the POS machine looked at my account and laughed."

title: LEKKI BIG BOY 🍾
subtitle: Too rich to japa! Opened a shisha lounge instead.
description: With this much cash in your bag, why freeze your fingers off cleaning offices in Berlin? You bought a white Benz, rented an apartment in {richArea}, and now tell people: 'Abroad is a scam, stay here!'
shareTitle: I became too wealthy to leave!
shareQuote: "Why wash plates in London when I can be Chairman here?"

title: EMBASSY BLACKLIST 🚔
subtitle: Caught with Comic Sans bank statement.
description: {@chidi} promised you a '100% original fake passport'. The consular officer shone an ultraviolet light on your visa and it glowed in three neon colors. Blacklisted until 2099!
shareQuote: "{@chidi} swore the seal was from the Queen herself."

title: BUREAUCRACY COMA 📑
subtitle: So legit the government suspected espionage.
description: You provided 89 notarized affidavits, 4 DNA samples, and a signed letter from your great-grandfather. The visa office opened an investigation into how anyone could be this flawless.
shareQuote: "My paperwork was too clean. They thought I was CIA."

title: TRENCHES BURNOUT 🛌
subtitle: Japa fatigue destroyed your will to live.
description: Standing in 4 AM queue in the pouring rain, watching 12 people in front get rejected with blue papers. You sat down on the curb, closed your eyes, and surrendered to the village gods.
shareQuote: "I just want to sleep and drink cold garri in peace."

title: DELUSIONAL VIBES 🤡
subtitle: Excessive ginger, absolutely zero preparation.
description: You entered the interview booth singing praises and told the consular officer: 'My visa was already stamped in heaven!' The white officer silently handed back your passport without opening it.
shareTitle: Escorted out of Embassy for too much confidence!
shareQuote: "No Gree for Anybody turned into No Visa for Anybody."

title: CLAN OUTCAST 🥀
subtitle: Disowned by maternal and paternal clans alike.
description: You blocked Mama on WhatsApp, skipped your uncle's funeral contribution, and refused to send prayer points. Mama declared a 7-day fasting against your journey, and all your doors shut.
shareTitle: Excommunicated from the Family WhatsApp Group!
shareQuote: "Nobody is sending prayers, nobody is sending money."

title: BLACK TAX SUFFOCATION 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
subtitle: 74 relatives demanded European allowances in advance.
description: Before you could even buy your flight ticket, uncle demanded a generator, auntie demanded money for triplets, and the youth wing arrived with a {$3333} budget. You were eaten alive.
shareTitle: Killed by family billing before packing suitcase!
shareQuote: "They calculated my Euro salary before I even saw snow."

title: BUSH FALLER CERTIFIED! 🏆❄️
subtitle: You conquered the ice, the agent, and the embassy!
description: Against all odds, you landed in Europe! You are shivering in a fake Moncler jacket, sharing a 1-bedroom flat with 7 guys in Peckham, but you posted a photo by Big Ben with caption: 'Grace Found Me!'

title: AGENT'S OFFICE REACHED 🏁
subtitle: You survived the market and the agent's street.
description: PLACEHOLDER (prototype end): the embassy, airport and first winter zones are coming next.
